sentences.text: Swapan Giri vs Unknown on 4 February, 2026

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
04.02.2026
Item no. 133.
Court No.35.
 Ab
(Rejected)
 Crm (M) 2091 of 2025
 In Re: An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of
 Criminal Procedure, 1973/Under Section 483 of the Bharatiya
 Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Pathar
 Pratima Police Station Case No.84 of 2020 Dated 07.08.2020
 under Sections 498A/302 of the Indian Penal Code
 And
 In the matter of : Swapan Giri
 ......Petitioner.
 Mr. Soumya Nag,
 Ms. Namrata Chatterjee ......for the Petitioner.
 Mr. Bitoshok Banerjee
 Mr. Prakash Mishra ......for the State.

1.
Petitioner is in custody for five years five months.
Only six witnesses have been examined.
2. Prosecution will conclude the evidence within the next six months.
3. Considering the earlier direction passed by this Court as well as the materials which were collected in course of investigation, at this stage, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
5. State is directed to communicate this order to the learned Trial Court forthwith.
6. Petitioner is at liberty to renew his prayer for bail after the aforesaid time period.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
